nodes.label: MongoDB Health Failure Shape
nodes.rationale: Preserves the full connection status response when remote probes fail, while making clear that HTTP 200 does not indicate a connected database.

nodes.label: Remote Filesystem Commands
nodes.rationale: Provides bounded filesystem operations over existing device routes and explicitly excludes arbitrary filesystem HTTP paths.

nodes.label: Integration Library Runtime
nodes.rationale: Uses fixed read-only provider operations, bounded and redacted transport, and a separately restricted SDK document; browser keys are excluded from saved Things.

nodes.label: Browser Action Programs
nodes.rationale: Adds capabilities through saved, editable program data and existing runtime contracts without adding endpoint-specific UI behavior or unnecessary endpoints and permissions.

nodes.label: Lopu Action Access

nodes.rationale: Adds a transient snapshot while preserving the canonical entry and existing branch-edit write path.

nodes.label: Webpage Component Previews
nodes.rationale: Reuses the viewer-only batch resolver with bounded blocks and exact scope, without granting page or root access.

nodes.label: Timeline Component Bindings
nodes.rationale: Bounds dependency count, decoded payload size, and response size, and refuses unknown or duplicate selectors, foreign accounts, and stale sources.

nodes.label: API Endpoints and Capabilities Feature Map
Password Manager
nodes.rationale: Keeps decrypted fields out of shared client history and cache; secret output remains in a controlled entry draft.

nodes.label: iOS TestFlight Delivery
nodes.rationale: Negotiates the origin manifest before requesting single-use credential delivery or an explicitly enabled create-only migration; origin fallback is prohibited.

nodes.label: Password Migration Coverage and Encrypted File Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Retains every original 1PUX member as an encrypted attachment to a source archive entry.

nodes.label: ChatGPT Plan Integration API
nodes.rationale: Local mode never falls back; explicit desktop remote selections negotiate and pin the receiving API before proxying.

nodes.label: Mapbox Provider Integration
nodes.rationale: Fixes provider destinations and redacts responses; CSP permits only Mapbox service and event origins and does not allow remote scripts or eval.

nodes.label: Storage Readiness and Recovery
nodes.rationale: Publishes shared deferred-accounting semantics and records only allowlisted storage failure codes without logging response bodies.

nodes.label: Connections Catalog and OAuth
nodes.rationale: Owner-private encrypted grants replace shared tokens; OAuth app configuration is exact-origin and environment scoped.

nodes.label: Environment Gateway and Index Readiness
nodes.rationale: Coordinates durable index readiness without blocking read-only authentication.

nodes.label: Public Social Metadata
nodes.rationale: Anonymous metadata uses an explicit allowlist, refuses remote URLs, resets custom data-plane selection and never resolves caller identity.

nodes.label: Named Connections Management
nodes.rationale: Verifies exact actor, origin, connection ID and fixed operation; token envelopes never cross the response boundary.

nodes.label: Connection Provider Artwork
nodes.rationale: Serves cached provider artwork from the document origin without opening a data-plane connection or forwarding user headers.

nodes.label: Dynamic Map Workspaces
nodes.rationale: A failed refresh clears only the map points layer.

nodes.label: Shared-Content Request Transport
nodes.rationale: The shared JSON reader admits authorization and rate limits before streaming fatal UTF-8 decoding and has no application body ceiling; other control requests retain numeric budgets.

nodes.label: Reviewed Creation Projections and Execution Admission
nodes.rationale: Held content is refused for server, browser, shared and child admission while preserving the hold in browse and Webpage projections.

nodes.label: Client Discovery Failure Classification
nodes.rationale: Separates network, deadline and HTTP discovery errors from parsing and compatibility failures; temporary errors may retain only an inert same-scope readable template.

nodes.label: Account-File Restore Writer Epoch Corrections
nodes.rationale: Fences writes, moves and drains of held restored content through the root content epoch.

nodes.label: Backup Dispatch Recovery
nodes.rationale: Reserves opaque attempt IDs before SDK start; browser calls cannot supply workflow run IDs, store addresses, original sessions or runnable intent.

nodes.label: First-Party Backup Workspace
nodes.rationale: Browser reads do not obtain provider configuration, session references, execution leases or writable intents.

nodes.label: Saved Private Page Activation
nodes.rationale: Verifies the exact private owner, page, revision, action and date and uses literal saved inputs; preview, edit and shared execution remain inert.
